pillars: Weird AI Experiments & Retro Tech Hacks
Conference Takeaways to Immediate Public Builds

plays.title: Post Quirky Retro-AI Hardware Projects
plays.description: Build and openly share strange experiments that combine vintage hardware with modern AI. Use curiosity-driven hooks and GitHub links to differentiate and demonstrate playful technical creativity.
plays.action:
1. Tinker with or finish a weird mashup like running an LLM on an old iMac G3 or CD-ROM setup.
2. Start the tweet with a surprising hook: "iMac LLM on a CD-ROM?!"
3. Follow immediately with the relatable detail and GitHub: "Luckily my G3 has a tray-loader\n\nhttps://github.com/maddiedreese/imac-llm"
4. Attach a photo of the hardware/setup.

plays.title: Turn Events into Visible Projects Fast
plays.description: Attend AI conferences, start executing on ideas the same day, and post an authentic recap thread that includes photos plus the specific project you began to prove follow-through and excitement.
plays.action:
1. Attend (or deeply consume) an AI event like aiDotEngineer.
2. Start a real project based on 1-2 talks as soon as you can — even on the flight home.
3. Post a recap thread: "I had an amazing time at my first @aiDotEngineer!" covering standout talks, people (and non-humans) met, and the project you started.
4. Share 3-4 photos that "sum up the experience pretty well."
5. Close with "Until next time!"

plays.title: Launch Weird Personal Benchmarks
plays.description: Create signature playful benchmarks (maddie-bench style) that test models on creative/human tasks using structured outputs, run comparative evals with blind judging, then announce and tease results to own the "weird evals" niche.
plays.action:
1. Design a fun, insightful eval (e.g. how well models "draw" your profile picture via structured JSON).
2. Test multiple models and use blind pairwise judging (by other models) to calculate Elo.
3. Announce the launch: "Introducing maddie-bench!" then explain exactly what it measures and frame it as "the first installment in my 'more weird evals' quest (and I think this one is decently weird)."
4. Post separate result teases: "Fable and Sonnet 5 results on maddie-bench!"
5. Link to the full leaderboard and details.

plays.title: Drop Nosy Builder Observations
plays.description: Publish short, voice-forward standalone tweets that reveal how you observe AI builder culture and everyday tech moments. These build personality, relatability, and easy engagement.
plays.action:
1. Notice a small, specific behavior (zooming into visible screens in photos, etc).
2. Write it in first person with direct voice: "I must tell you: if you post a picture with your screen visible, I’m zooming in on your screen and reading everything on it. Sorry. I’m nosy."
3. Post as a single tweet. No links, threads, or extra CTAs unless they feel completely natural.

hooks: Building strange AI things in public.
I must tell you: if you post a picture with your screen visible, I’m zooming in on your screen and reading everything on it. Sorry. I’m nosy.
